item.title: Terra Metals Confirms Further PGM Discovery at Dante’s Southwest Prospect
item.description: Terra Metals (ASX:TM1) has made a second platinum group metal discovery at the Southwest prospect within its Dante project in Western Australia, confirming mineralisation occurs across separate sections of the Southwest area.

item.title: Mithril Silver and Gold Starts Maiden Drilling Campaign at Copalquin District’s Target 3
item.description: Mithril Silver and Gold (ASX: MTH) has commenced a 3,300-metre drilling campaign at Target 3 within its Copalquin District gold-silver project in Mexico’s Durango state.

item.title: Kuniko Prepares for Phase 1 Drilling at Commonwealth Project under Earn-In Agreement with Impact Minerals
item.description: Under an earn-in and joint venture agreement with project owner Impact Minerals (ASX: IPT), Kuniko (ASX: KNI) has completed a MobileMT airborne electromagnetic program over 328 line-km of the Commonwealth gold-silver-copper project in NSW.

item.title: Proteomics International Obtains Canadian Patent for PromarkerEso Blood Test
item.description: Proteomics International Laboratories (ASX: PIQ) has secured new intellectual property protection in Canada, after the country’s Patent Office granted a patent for its PromarkerEso blood test for esophageal adenocarcinoma.

item.title: Austral Resources Australia Acquires Lady Loretta Mine to Expand Copper Pipeline
item.description: Austral Resources Australia (ASX: AR1) has entered into an agreement with Glencore AG to acquire the Lady Loretta mining leases, associated exploration permits, and site infrastructure.

item.title: Zelira Therapeutics Receives US$33m in Funding to Advance HOPE 1 Autism Program
item.description: Zelira Therapeutics (ASX: ZLD) has secured US$32.98 million in new funding after its HOPE 1 special purpose vehicle signed definitive agreements with US-based life sciences investor ThirdGate Capital's TGC Biotechnology Fund.

item.title: Dalaroo Metals Identifies District-Scale Critical Minerals System at Blue Lagoon Project in Greenland
item.description: Dalaroo Metals (ASX: DAL) has identified a large, coherent critical minerals system at its 100%-owned Blue Lagoon project in Greenland, following the first modern sampling program conducted at the project since 1979.

item.title: European Lithium Unearths Significant Rare Earth Mineralisation at Tanbreez Project in Greenland
item.description: European Lithium (ASX: EUR) has identified wide zones of rare-earth mineralisation in initial assays from 2025 drilling at the Fjord deposit and Upper Fjord areas at its Tanbreez project in Greenland.

item.title: 1414 Degrees Gets Key Approval from AEMO for Aurora BESS Power Grid Plans
item.description: 1414 Degrees (ASX: 14D) has received a key approval from the Australian Energy Market Operator (AEMO) as part of its plans to connect the Aurora 140MW Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) to the Australian power network.

item.title: Weekly Wrap: Winning Streak Persists as Tech, Banks Drive Aussie Shares
item.description: ASX 200 rises 0.5% to 8,903 as tech and banks lead; miners retreat, with Capstone Copper and Catalyst Metals rallying on strong results.
